subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Should the Feishu multi-bot mention fix proceed as a union_id-based rewrite, switch to another proven cross-app identity strategy, or wait for broader Feishu multi-bot identity work?
rationale: The submitted identity source is disputed, the branch conflicts on the identity surface, and the choice directly affects whether Feishu group messages are admitted, suppressed, or misrouted.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework this PR on current main only after proving the stable Feishu identity field exists in real bot/group payloads and covering all mention-admission paths.

options.title: Replace With Alias Mapping
options.body: Close or supersede this branch after a narrower replacement maps known cross-app open_id variants without relying on unavailable bot union_id data.

options.title: Keep As Investigation Context
options.body: Leave the PR open but do not merge it while broader Feishu multi-bot identity work determines the permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework this PR on current main only after proving the stable Feishu identity field exists in real bot/group payloads and covering all mention-admission paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned, requested changes on the PR, and are the recent current-main owner for the Feishu identity/mention helper paths.
